title: Signed Q3 source-slice top filtration and quartic history boundary
question: Does the signed full source-slice operator P(a)D_a cancel the highest-degree quartic branch that survived the positive majorant audit, or does degree filtration retain it in both orientations?

model.signed_source_slice: At q=v=0, both registered source orientations reduce exactly to P(a)=-(51/140)a^4-2a^2.
model.degree_filtration: The quartic term raises degree by 3 after D_a, while the quadratic term raises degree by 1; hence the degree 1+3m top coefficient cannot receive a lower-term contribution.
model.norm_boundary: The absolute top coefficient gives the same factorial-seminorm lower witness as R290 at S=1/4 and S'=1/8.

scope.not_closed: This rejects cancellation only in the formal signed source-slice degree filtration. It does not rule out multivariate Q3 commutator cancellations, state-weighted estimates, an unbounded common core, QFT reconstruction, the gap, the continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The q=v=0 slice is recomputed from the center and reverse source polynomials, including the lower quadratic term.
The recurrence is generated with the signed polynomial P, and only the final norm uses the absolute top coefficient.
The quadratic branch raises degree by one and cannot reach degree 1+3m, so it cannot cancel the top quartic branch.
Both source orientations have the same signed slice and the same top-degree rows.
The order-sixteen witness is an exact finite rational row; the asymptotic statement uses the factorial lower bound and does not infer a thermodynamic limit.
Lean R291 checks only the rational slice and finite top-degree witness, not the Q3 operator domain or histories.
No common alpha, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.

qft_interface.closed: The signed source-slice top degree survives exactly in both orientations and reproduces the factorial top-branch boundary.
qft_interface.open: Multivariate signed Q3 commutator cancellations, common-core realization, state-weighted histories, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian/KMS identification, OS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied by this formal slice test.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing route boundary. The signed formal source slice has no top-degree cancellation, but this is not a no-go theorem for the full Q3 dynamics or QFT.
next_action: Leave the source-slice analytic route parked and attack a genuinely multivariate cancellation-aware or state-weighted common-core estimate before common-alpha promotion.
